name: impeccable
description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
one_liner: A set of design rules and commands you give an AI coding tool so the websites it builds stop looking like every other AI-built website.
buyer: A freelance developer or small product team who ships client or internal sites with AI coding tools and keeps getting called out for the same generic 'AI look'.
business_use_cases: A freelance web developer runs `/impeccable polish` on every client delivery as a final quality gate before handoff, reducing revision cycles.
A startup's one-person design-and-dev team uses the 24 commands (critique, harden, onboard) to cover UX review work it can't afford to hire a designer for.
A design agency builds a 'design audit' service around the deterministic detector rules, selling a scored report plus fixes to clients with existing sites.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a flat-fee 'design audit and polish' package built on the audit and polish commands.
Offer a retainer that re-runs the audit commands on a client's site monthly as it grows.

steal_this: Run `/impeccable audit` and `/impeccable polish` against three of your own past client projects this weekend and turn the before/after screenshots into a cold-outreach portfolio piece.
